test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct replacement:

The doctor advised him __to avoid eating sweets and doing exercise regularly.__

options.text: avoids sweets and doing regular exercise
to avoid sweets and to exercises regularly
to avoid eating sweets and to exercise regularly
to not eat sweets and do exercises

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires parallelism in structure when listing actions advised by the doctor.
 
• The phrase "**to avoid eating sweets**" must pair with "**to exercise regularly**" for grammatical consistency.
 
• Option 3 correctly maintains this parallel structure with "**to avoid eating sweets and to exercise regularly**."
 
• The other options either lack parallelism or use incorrect grammar.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The doctor advised him to avoid eating sweets and to exercise regularly."__*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "avoids sweets and doing regular exercise" lacks the parallel structure.
 
• **Option 2:** "to avoid sweets and to exercises regularly" uses incorrect grammar ("to exercises" should be "to exercise").
 
• **Option 4:** "to not eat sweets and do exercises" lacks proper parallel structure and uses inconsistent verb forms.
